name: Eleven Flash v2.5
access: ElevenLabs API: Text to Speech (HTTP, stream, WebSocket, multi-context WebSocket)

voice.output_audio: MP3 (22.05 kHz at 32 kbps, 24 kHz at 48 kbps, 44.1 kHz at 32 to 192 kbps), PCM 8 to 48 kHz 16-bit, WAV 8 to 48 kHz, Opus 48 kHz (32 to 192 kbps), mu-law 8 kHz and A-law 8 kHz; the default is mp3_44100_128; MP3 at 192 kbps needs the Creator plan or above, and PCM or WAV at 44.1 kHz needs Pro or above [el-api-tts]
voice.voices: custom cloning: library voices (the maker's pages give 3,000+, 10,000+ and 5,000+ as counts), instant and professional voice clones, and designed voices [el-tts-overview] [el-voices]
languages: 32 languages: the 29 of Multilingual v2 plus Hungarian, Norwegian and Vietnamese [el-models]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model. WebSocket input is flushed with flush: true at the end of an agent turn [el-ws-tts]
voice.interruption: Not handled by the model. The multi-context WebSocket lets a client close one context and open another when a user cuts in, with up to 5 contexts per connection [el-ws-multi]
voice.latency: About 75 ms model inference, excluding application and network latency [el-models]; with the WebSocket, time to first byte of 100 to 150 ms in North America, Europe and South East Asia and 150 to 200 ms in South Asia and North East Asia [el-latency-opt]
voice.session_limit: 40,000 characters per request, about 40 minutes of audio [el-models]; the WebSocket closes after 20 seconds of inactivity unless the client sends a space (inactivity_timeout is configurable); a multi-context socket allows up to 180 seconds [el-ws-tts] [el-ws-multi]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. API list price US$0.04 per 1,000 characters, shared with Flash v2 and the deprecated Turbo models on the pricing page [el-pricing-api]; the launch post says 1 credit per 2 characters [el-blog-flash]. Artificial Analysis lists US$50 per 1M characters, which does not match the list price [aa-tts-board]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (provider voice leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes on ElevenLabs's own voices; the model page gives 1076.29 and the leaderboard table read the same day gives 1078.14

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis text-to-speech median characters per second
benchmarks.setting: median generation speed; read from the leaderboard data on the Artificial Analysis text-to-speech page

benchmarks.name: Maker model inference latency (milliseconds)
benchmarks.setting: approximate figure, excluding application and network latency
